faqHeading: Questions we get about ChatGPT Ads

pageBuilder.headline: Reach buyers while they are still deciding, inside ChatGPT
pageBuilder.subheadline: Your customers now work through their options in a conversation, not a results page. We build and run paid placements inside that conversation, with the same discipline we apply to search and shopping.

children.text: Assistant traffic behaves differently from a results page. Intent arrives mid-conversation, sessions are longer, and a single answer can end the search. Most teams either ignore the channel or treat it like display inventory.
We run it as performance media: measured against pipeline, not impressions.

bullets: Placements built around buying questions, not broad audiences
Creative written for a conversation, not a banner slot
Spend judged against qualified pipeline, not impressions
Overlap with your paid search and shopping accounts managed deliberately
Reporting that shows what the channel added, not what it touched
pageBuilder.eyebrow: Work with us on ChatGPT Ads
pageBuilder.heading: A new placement, not a new set of rules

challenges: Intent is buried mid-conversation — The commercial moment is rarely the first message. Targeting the opening question wastes most of the budget.
Attribution does not look like search — Sessions are long and often end off-platform. Without a measurement plan agreed upfront, results become an argument.
Creative that reads like an ad gets ignored — A placement inside an answer has to be useful in the same sentence it sells. Repurposed display copy fails here.
It cannibalises what you already pay for — Run without controls, the channel buys clicks your brand search was getting for less. That needs watching from day one.
pageBuilder.eyebrow: Why this is hard to get right
pageBuilder.heading: The channel is young. The mistakes are already predictable.
pageBuilder.subtext: Four problems account for most of the wasted spend we see when we take over an existing account.

bullets: One team across search, shopping and assistants — The same people running your paid search run this, so overlap and cannibalisation get caught rather than reported later.
Measurement agreed before spend — We define what counts as a result, how it is tracked, and what the channel has to beat, in writing, before the first campaign goes live.
Creative written for conversational placements — Copy that answers the question it appears next to. Tested in small batches rather than shipped as one big idea.
Senior involvement throughout — A small team, with the people who scoped the work still on the account at month six.

steps.stepDescription: We review your paid search and shopping data to find the questions worth buying, and what a click should be worth.
Tracking, objectives and account structure set up first, then campaigns built against them.
A capped test across two or three placement types, with creative variants, run long enough to read.
Budget moves to what holds up. Monthly reporting covers what changed and what we are changing next.
